svg.title: Lee Perry-Smith: scan portrait (bust)
svg.desc: Infinite, 3D Head Scan by Lee Perry-Smith (Infinite-Realities), licensed under CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), as distributed with three.js r150. Changed: Loop-subdivided twice and drawn as a line engraving. Stroke-only plot: view bust, pen 0.15 mm, sheet Codex plot master, A4. Layers: 1 ground, 2 hatch, 3 cross-hatch, 4 fold lines, 5 outlines.
